quotes.text: Our PG&E team continues to make meaningful progress delivering safe, affordable, reliable, and clean energy to our customers.

outlook: Full year 2026 and 2027 non-GAAP core EPS guidance reaffirmed at $1.64 to $1.66 per share and $1.78 to $1.82 per share, respectively.

Filed a 5,000-mile undergrounding plan with California regulators designed to reduce wildfire risk by 98% and outages by 90% on lines moved underground, which is expected to deliver an estimated $117 billion in long-term benefits.
PG&E Corporation is reaffirming its full year 2026 and 2027 non-GAAP core earnings guidance range of $1.64 to $1.66 per share and $1.78 to $1.82 per share, respectively.

items.heading: The Wildfire Fund, Continuation Account, and other provisions of AB 1054 and SB 254 may not effectively mitigate the risk of liability for damages arising from catastrophic wildfires.

PG&E Corporation’s and the Utility’s liabilities for the 2019 Kincade fire, the 2021 Dixie fire, the 2022 Mosquito fire, or the Wildfire-Related Securities Claims could exceed their estimated liabilities, or they could be liable as a result of future wildfires.
The Utility may be unable to recover all or a significant portion of its costs in excess of insurance coverage in connection with wildfires through rates.
The Utility may not effectively implement its wildfire mitigation initiatives.
The Utility’s ratemaking and cost recovery proceedings may not authorize sufficient revenues, or the Utility’s actual costs could exceed its authorized or forecasted costs.
An Enhanced Oversight and Enforcement Process proceeding could result in the Utility losing its license to operate as a utility.
